reason: Adds a settings panel that lists Cordis Loader plugins and lets users start or stop them, with persistent configuration changes and a local unauthenticated API route.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置中新增插件启停控制面板，用于查看并启动或停止 Cordis Loader 插件。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness Web settings panel for viewing and starting or stopping Cordis Loader plugins.

capabilities: Adds a settings tab for listing Cordis Loader plugins
Enables or disables selected plugins through a local HTTP route
Persists plugin enablement state in Loader configuration
